messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for private installer port bindings + KMS/HSM notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Need quick QA on the network matrix and an air-gapped snippet.

ajay: Thanks — which ports should we list for mutual TLS between nodes and KMS/HSM? Is 7943 still used for agent-to-KMS?

kevin: For HSM PKCS#11 plugin we only require the HSM API port (16963) + KMS overlay (443). Agent -> KMS is 7943 for legacy clients but we should call out 443 as preferred. See proposed table in PR lines 45-58.

lina: Also: air-gapped note — mirror apt/yum + GPG keys. Example to add: `curl -fsSL http://mirror.local/gpg | apt-key add -` and mention `trusted.gpg.d` placement.

kevin: Adding nftables example and a systemd hint for kms-proxy. Snippet you can paste into docs: 
```bash
# nftables: allow control plane and KMS/HSM from management network
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
nft add rule inet redwood input ip saddr 10.0.32.0/24 tcp dport {443,16963,7943} accept
```
Also add a note: if using SR-IOV/HSM with direct passthrough, include `--host-pci=on` in the installer example.

docs-bot: docs-lint: failing — broken link in PR to `private/install#network` (404). Please fix anchors or create the target header.

maria: Good catch — fixing anchor to `private/vpc/install#networking` and updating the PR.

ajay: KMS env sample for SDKs: `export KMS_ENDPOINT=https://kms.internal:443` and `export REDWOOD_PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/pkcs11/libhsm.so`. Do we prefer absolute paths in docs or placeholders?

lina: Use placeholders with examples: `REDWOOD_PKCS11_MODULE=/var/lib/pkcs11/<vendor>.so` and add a brief HSM note about permission/selinux contexts. For offline installer callout, mention `--allow-local-repos` and checksum verification: 
```bash
# offline installer example
./installer --airgap --mirror /mnt/mirror --allow-local-repos --verify-checksums
```

kevin: Also add HSM cert rotation steps under troubleshooting: after updating PKCS#11 config, run `systemctl restart kms-proxy` and check `journalctl -u kms-proxy -u installer -f` for errors.

maria: @kevin @lina can one of you push the nftables + offline snippets to the PR? I'll squash and add a changelog entry once docs-lint passes. tagging @ajay for final network review.

ajay: :thumbsup: I'll review the network table tonight. If the lint and link fixes are green, I'll approve.

maria: Thanks everyone — assigning reviewers and will merge after docs-lint passes. :rocket:
